summary: The PR addresses an issue related to Meta.ordering fields being included in the GROUP BY clause, but it introduces a new condition that may not cover all scenarios.

issues.description: The change only skips adding order_by fields to GROUP BY if _meta_ordering is False. This might not handle cases where _meta_ordering is True but the ordering fields should not be included in GROUP BY.
The code style does not match the surrounding code, particularly in the comment formatting and spacing.
